Name: Fixed Assets Master Data
Description:

Aggregates information from the following Data Sources: Fixed Assets Master Data. 

This data source forms the basis for the following key report: Fixed Assets - Master Data

Name: Fixed Assets Account Balances
Description:
Provides data for the balances and totals of your fixed asset accounts in company currency. The account movements are shown using the closing balance and current totals in the selected fiscal periods. 

Aggregates information from the following Data Sources: Fixed assets period-based totals and balances aggregated by line item type, G/L account, posted profit center and posted segment, and G/L-relevant information. 

This data source forms the basis for the following key report: Fixed Assets - Trial Balance.

Name: G/L Account
Description: Provides the master data of the G/L accounts for a specific Chart of Accounts. This conatins detailed data about G/L accounts, such as G/L Account Type, and Indicators such as Profit /Loss Account Indicator, G/L Account Posting Block Indicators, Open Item Management Indicators.

Name: G/L Account Period Totals / Balances
Description: Provides data for the balances and totals of your individual G/L accounts and G/L account types in company currency and line item currency. The account movements are shown using the opening balance, the credit and debit, and the closing balance in the selected fiscal periods. Aggregates information from the following Data Sources: Business Configuration (Chart of Accounts); General Ledger (General Ledger Account Totals and Balances). This data source forms the basis for the following key reports: Trial Balance; Trial Balance - Two Years; Balances on Favorite Accounts; Schedule of Changes; Balance Audit Trail.

Name: G/L Account Items
Description: Provides data for the line items of your G/L accounts. You can also display the line items of an individual G/L account or multiple G/L accounts. From the line items, you can view the relevant journal entries. You can include different details from the relevant document, such as the cost center, clearing date, or document number of the clearing document. Aggregates information from the following Data Sources: General Ledger (Line Items); Journal Entry (Items and Subledger Extensions); Subledgers, Offsetting Information. This data source forms the basis for the following key reports: G/L Accounts - Line Items; G/L Accounts - Open Items; Balance Audit Trail.

Name: Journal Entries
Description: Provides data for the journal entries that were posted to G/L accounts. The journal entries are recorded in chronological order by document number, document type, and posting date. For each journal entry, the individual line items are also displayed with the accounts to which the entry was posted and the amount in company currency and line item currency. Aggregates information from the following Data Sources: Journal Entry (Items and Subledger Extensions); Subledgers; Offsetting Information. This data source forms the basis for the following key reports: Journal; Journal - Print Layout.

Name: Financial Statements
Description: Provides data for the hierarchical display of G/L account balances in company currency based on different reporting structures: balance sheets, profit and loss statements, and cash flow statements. You can choose to analyze data for different fiscal year and accounting period combinations and also compare data for two different fiscal years. Three different types of balance sheet calculations are provided: cumulative, changes in current period and cumulative balance sheet, changes for income statement. Aggregates information from the following Data Sources: Business Configuration (Chart of Accounts, Reporting Structures); General Ledger (General Ledger Account Totals and Balances). This data source forms the basis for the following key reports: Financial Statements; Financial Statements - Two Years; Financial Statements - Print Layout.

Name: ARP Ledger Account Balances
Description: Provides data for the balances and totals of your individual accounts receivables and payables in company currency and line item currency. The account movements are shown using the opening balance, the credit and debit, and the closing balance in the selected fiscal periods. Aggregates information from the following Data Sources: Receivables and Payables (Totals and Balances). This data source forms the basis for the following key reports: Accounts Receivable - Trial Balance, Accounts Payable - Trial Balance.

Name: ARP Ledger Account Line Items
Description: Provides data for the line items of your accounts receivable and accounts payable accounts in company currency, transaction currency, and line item currency. For each line item, the posting date, document type, and document number are shown. Aggregates information from the following Data Sources: Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable Line Items, Offsetting Information. This data source forms the basis for the following key reports: Accounts Receivable - Line Items; Accounts Payable - Line Items; Accounts Receivable - Open Items; Accounts Payable - Open Items; Accounts Receivable – Balance Audit Trail; Accounts Payable - Balance Audit Trail.

Name: Cash Ledger Account Balances
Description: Provides data for the balances and totals of your individual cash ledger accounts in company currency and line item currency. The account movements are shown using the opening balance, the credit and debit, and the closing balance in the selected fiscal periods. Aggregates information from the following Data Source: Cash Ledger Account (Totals and Balances). This data source forms the basis for the following key reports: Cash - Trial Balance; Cash  - Balance Audit Trail.

Name: Cash Ledger Account Line Items
Description: Provides data for the balances and line items of your individual G/L accounts and G/L account types in company currency and line item currency. For the individual line items for G/L accounts, you can include additional details such as the cost center. The balance audit trail shows the balance at the start of a specific period and the way in which the balance of the account changed by the end of the period. Aggregates information from the following Data Sources: General Ledger Account Line Items; General Ledger Account Totals and Balances; Offsetting Information. This data source forms the basis for the following key report: Balance Audit Trail.

Name: G/L Balance Audit Trail

The balance audit trail shows the balance at the start of a specific period and the way in which the balance of the account changed by the end of the period. Aggregates information from the following Data Sources: General Ledger Account Line Items; General Ledger Account Totals and Balances; Offsetting Information. This data source forms the basis for the following key report: Balance Audit Trail.

Name: ARP Balance Audit Trail
Description: Provides data for the balances and line items of your individual accounts receivable and accounts payable accounts in company currency and line item currency. For the individual line items for accounts receivable and accounts payable, you can include additional details such as the cost center. The balance audit trail shows the balance at the start of a specific period and the way in which the balance of the account changed by the end of the period. Aggregates information from the following Data Sources: Accounts Receivables / Accounts Payables Ledger Account Line Items; Accounts Receivables / Accounts Payables Ledger Account Totals and Balances; Offsetting Information. This data source forms the basis for the following key reports: Accounts Receivable Balance Audit Trail; Accounts Payable Balance Audit Trail.

Name: Cash Balance Audit Trail
Description: Provides data for the balances and line items of your individual cash ledger accounts  in company currency and line item currency. For the individual line items for  cash ledger accounts, you can include additional details such as the profit center. The balance audit trail shows the balance at the start of a specific period and the way in which the balance of the account changed by the end of the period. Aggregates information from the following Data Sources: Cash Ledger Account Line Items; Cash Ledger Account Totals and Balances; Offsetting Information. This data source forms the basis for the following key report: Cash Ledger Account Balance Audit Trail.

Description: Displays predictive profit data based on sales orders, service orders, and sales returns. By unifying the data from CRM orders, it enables contribution margin reports that provide a preliminary indication of what future profit may be. Displays profit data for analysis by multiple market segments, such as all customers in a particular region and customer group. Invoice profit information supports analyses such as: (1) Profit drilldowns for determining the contribution margins of customer groups, territories, and sales organizations; (2) Rest-of-year forecasting; (3) Analysis of seasonal effects on profit and the impact of pricing and rebates. Aggregates information from the following Data Source: Profitability: Customer Invoices.

Name: Profitability : Earned Profit

Aggregates information from the following Data Sources: Profitability: General Ledger; Profitability: Overhead Cost Ledger; Profitability: Other Direct Cost Ledger; Profitability: Material Ledger; Profitability: Sales Ledger.

Name: Sales Ledger Line Items

Aggregates information from the following Data Source: Profitability: Sales Ledger Line Items.

Name: Profitability Management
Description: Provides profit data for analysis by multiple market segments such as all customers in a particular region and customer group. You can choose to analyze profit by detailed attributes such as sales documents, GL accounts, and journal entry IDs. Three methods are supported to calculate the profit, which are based on financial accounting data (for earned profit), or sales documents (for order or invoice profit). Aggregates information from the following Data Sources: Profitability: Order Profit; Profitability: Invoice Profit; Profitability: Earned Profit. This data source forms the basis for the following key reports: Profit Detail by Contribution Margin Scheme; Profit Overview by Key Figure; Key Performance Indicators, and Dashboards based on Profitability.
